summary.en: An atom has a tiny, dense, positively charged nucleus made of protons and neutrons, surrounded by electrons; atoms of the same element with different neutron counts are called isotopes.
summary.et: Aatomil on väike, tihe ja positiivselt laetud tuum, mis koosneb prootonitest ja neutronitest, ning seda ümbritsevad elektronid; sama elemendi erineva neutronite arvuga aatomeid nimetatakse isotoopideks.
